description:
Return confirmed customer domains currently known for a specified technology/vendor; STRAELO-confirmed coverage, not a complete global installed base.
USE WHEN: agent needs confirmed customer domains currently known for a specified technology/vendor.
DO NOT USE WHEN: domain -> technologies; vendor + time -> ADDED/REMOVED; competitor switch/replacement signals.
USE technology-intelligence FOR: technologies detected on a public domain.
USE change-intelligence FOR: durable ADDED/REMOVED changes for a vendor within a UTC time window.
USE competitor-switch-intelligence FOR: competitor switch/replacement signals.

vendor.description: Technology/vendor to query confirmed customers for (e.g., klaviyo, yotpo, judge.me).
vendor.title: Vendor

name: installed_base_intelligence

confirmed_customer_count.description: Total confirmed PRESENT customers for the vendor.

customers.description: Confirmed customer relationships, ordered by confirmation freshness.

customer_domain.description: Confirmed customer domain using the technology/vendor.

fingerprint_identifiers.items: Fingerprint identifiers that matched during confirmation.

last_confirmed_at.description: UTC timestamp when the PRESENT relationship was last confirmed.

response_validity.description: Response validity of the confirming observation.

scanner_version.description: Scanner version that produced the confirmation.

returned_count.description: Number of customers returned in this response (bounded by limit).

title: STRAELO Installed Base Intelligence
